scoring_justification: Full recompute (T1) is infeasible because it would require re-running DFT calculations. Comparing the agent's reported activation barriers to the paper's published values within a tolerance and checking the ordering is appropriate.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper – low-coverage barriers from Fig. 7 and text: TiO2 1.037 eV, CeO2 0.824 eV, BNO 0.798 eV; high-coverage barriers from Fig. 9 and text: TiO2 0.475 eV, CeO2 0.352 eV, BNO 0.320 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published article's quantitative results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numeric values reported in the paper; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: Activation barriers for the Langmuir-Hinshelwood ethylene hydrogenation step under low H coverage (2 H) and high H coverage (6 H) on three supported Ni4 catalysts. Lower values indicate better catalytic performance.

output_contract.notes: The barriers must be positive numbers in eV. The ordering Ni4/BNO < Ni4/CeO2 < Ni4/TiO2 must hold at each coverage.

steps.description: Validate reported activation barriers against paper gold with tolerance and check ordering.
